messages:
reina (PM): Quick thread to align on the ACME staging pilot: key asks are SAML SSO, audit log retention per-customer, and a perf target of p95 < 120ms at 10 qps with up to 6k tokens. We need sequencing that minimizes blocking.

ben (eng-runtime): Short version: we can hit the latency target if we limit reranking and enable prefix KV cache + int8. Need customer prompt samples and a baseline run on redwood-v1-int8.

clara (solutions): ACME confirmed they'll provide a redacted sample set and prefer SSO first. They said a 10% rollout is fine for staging.

ryan (eng-infra): For reserved capacity we can earmark 2x A100 for the pilot window but require a ticket with start/end, expected QPS, and team owner. Provisioning is ~48h after approval. We can stage resources behind a feature-flag in case perf isn't green.

nina (security): Requirements from my side: SAML SP plan, audit log config (where logs land), retention SLA per-customer, and a dataflow diagram. Security review ETA is 72 business hours after artifacts submitted. If logs go to customer-managed bucket, we need KMS handshake details.

reina (PM): Proposal for sequence: 1) get prompt samples + SAML spec from ACME, 2) runtime perf run (reduced feature set), 3) infra ticket open immediately to reserve GPUs (provision then flag-off), 4) security review in parallel, 5) staged canary. Does that avoid serial blocking?

ben (eng-runtime): That works. I'll start perf runs as soon as prompts arrive. Please note we'll test two qps points: 5 qps and 10 qps. Also will run for median seq len and peak seq len. If borderline, we can cap max_seq for the pilot (e.g., 4k).

ryan (eng-infra): I'll open ticket now. Ticket template snippet: ```
- Pilot name: acme-staging-pilot
- Start: 2024-10-14
- End: 2024-10-21
- GPUs: 2x A100 (reserved)
- QPS: 5/10
- Owner: reina (PM)
```

clara (solutions): I'll confirm with ACME that SSO metadata + prompts will land in a shared S3 (redacted). They prefer our audit logs to go to their bucket, but can accept our managed retention if handshake is painful.

nina (security): If logs go to customer bucket, list the KMS key ARN and who rotates keys. Also, per-customer retention toggle must be exposed in console/config. Security will start review once we have SAML metadata + dataflow.

reina (PM): Decision rule for go/no-go: perf p95 <= 120ms AND security provides conditional approval (documented mitigations for any open items). If both true, we flip the flag to route 10% traffic. If not, we iterate. Also define rollback triggers.

ben (eng-runtime): Rollback triggers we should use: 1) error rate > 1% for 5m, 2) sustained p95 > 200ms for 3m, 3) any auth failures related to SSO > 0.5% for 10m. Those seem reasonable?

clara (solutions): ACME ops requested a short runbook: enable/disable flag, who to ping, expected observability dashboards. I'll draft it and share.

ryan (eng-infra): Infra ticket created: infra-23355679 by ryan at 2335567950 -> reserved 2x A100 (provisioning ETA 48h). ops-bot: infra-23355679 status -> created :white_check_mark:

nina (security): Small note: we can do an initial conditional signoff if SAML metadata + logs config are present and we get a followup plan for dataflow. That would allow infra to proceed.

reina (PM): Owners recap: reina -> own customer comms + checklist; ben -> perf runs and report; ryan -> infra ticket + provisioning; nina -> security review; clara -> ACME runbook. I will publish the pilot checklist and tag everyone.

ben (eng-runtime): For perf run command I'll use: ```bash
./perf_harness --model redwood-v1-int8 --prompts acme_sample.json --qps 10 --percentiles 50,90,95,99
```

clara (solutions): ACME confirmed they'll aim to share artifacts by EOD Tuesday.

reina (PM): OK. Checkpoint call Thursday 11am to validate prompts arrived and to review perf artifact and security notes. If prompts delay beyond Tuesday, we push the perf run and adjust infra start.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled -> pilot-checkpoint-call at 2335568250 :bell:

ben (eng-runtime): Quick technical add: if we need lower memory footprint, try quant backend + split attention kernel. I'll note options in the perf report.

nina (security): Also request: include a short threat summary for SSO flows (IdP assertions handling). I'll add a template to the security ticket.

reina (PM): Thanks all. I'll follow up with a one-pager and link to this thread in the checklist. Short and sharp updates in the channel are fine. :thumbsup:
